sources.entry: Is It Private? - A Safari Extension providing a toolbar icon that changes its visual appearance if Private Browsing is enabled.

summary.one_liner: A Safari App Extension for macOS that adds a toolbar icon which changes appearance when Private Browsing is enabled.
summary.what_it_does: Adds a Safari toolbar icon that visually changes when Private Browsing is active, so the state is visible at a glance. The README says this is especially helpful when macOS Dark appearance is on. It is distributed as a macOS app bundle that contains the Safari extension. The README states the app does not store or transmit personal details and includes no advertising, tracking, or third-party analytics. Installation is possible from the App Store, from a zipped app on GitHub Releases, or by building the Xcode project from source. The README does not describe configuration options or further features.
use_cases: See at a glance whether Safari is in a private window
Tell private and normal Safari windows apart in Dark Mode
Install a Safari toolbar indicator on macOS
Build a Safari app extension from Xcode source
how_to_run: Open the GitHub releases page and download IsItPrivate.app.zip from the latest release
Unzip the file and move IsItPrivate.app into your Applications folder
Clone the repository or download the source code of the latest release
notable: Toolbar icon changes appearance when Safari Private Browsing is on
Helpful specifically with macOS Dark appearance
Privacy policy states no personal data stored or transmitted and no analytics or tracking
Available on the App Store as well as GitHub Releases
caveats: Requires macOS with Safari; the README does not list minimum versions
The README does not describe features beyond the toolbar icon
